source_evidence: Player exact 'Good, then we will formalize with we all meet later. I will talk to the guild' directs relay of existing negotiated compromise to guild and later formalization, no new V commitments. Commander agrees to formalize at public meeting; V returns to organizer/quartermaster and presents agreed conditional terms. They voluntarily support lawful rapid release protocol and can arrange authorized deputy coverage using guild personnel at own expense. They require written rescission and formal agreement at meeting, no transfer of armory keys or unapproved weapons, no V liability. No opposed check because directly aligns with stated desire for lawful defense and custody, no forced concession, no outcome claimed before meeting. D315~14:45 Caereth guildhall records room, V and party with district organizer and guild quartermaster. V tells commander that terms can be formalized when parties meet later and proceeds to consult guild. V conveys previously agreed conditional proposal: guild retains armory keys and stock custody; quartermaster or authorized deputy available continuously; prompt documented release of explicitly authorized equipment under agreed mobilization trigger and lawful authority; commander rescinds unilateral demand and publicly acknowledges guild custody. Quartermaster and organizer voluntarily agree to endorse these terms at 16:00 meeting, with staffing arranged from existing guild personnel at guild responsibility, not V's expense; no independent emergency powers for contractor. They want written rescission and actual agreed protocol before final implementation. No check needed because terms protect guild's expressed objectives and are voluntary. No public meeting yet, actual commander rescission or binding agreement executed, no reward paid. V can prepare or proceed to meeting.
